name: Minkowski Sum Boundary Rendering via Primitive Culling
aliases: GPU-based Minkowski Sum Boundary Rendering via Primitive Culling
definition: A GPU-based algorithm to render the outer boundaries of Minkowski sums (A ⊕ B) without computing a complete boundary representation. It generates a superset of surface primitives (triangles and quadrilaterals) and culls invalid ones using geometric propositions, then renders the remaining primitives.
